## Core concepts

### FullAgenticStack
An agentic architecture connecting human intent to classification, orchestration, agents, multimodal interaction, A2UI, projections, observability and self-healing execution.

### AllasCode
Human-intent-bound architecture for conversational automation. The central application is primarily responsible for classification and orchestration, while domain behavior is represented semantically and executed by agents and runtimes.

### Outcome as a Software (OaaS)
A software model centered on achieving and accepting an outcome instead of merely exposing software features or screens.

### Agent-Actor-Action (A3)
An ontology connecting AtomicSkill → AtomicBehavior → Action → Actor → Runtime for executable agentic systems.

### Semantic-as-Code
A development approach where semantic declarations, contracts, behaviors and implementation meaning are first-class artifacts of software engineering.

### Trajectory-Driven Development (T-DD)
A verification-oriented development model connecting DESTINY → INTENT → BEHAVIOR → EVIDENCE → CONTRACT → STATE → ACTOR → SKILL → TRAJECTORY → DSL → IMPLEMENTATION.

### Intent-Driven Development
A development approach in which user intent is a first-class driver of behavior, contracts, verification and implementation.

### 2flow
A notation for representing intent-driven execution flows, behaviors and agentic orchestration.

### PreCog / 2nd Brain
A second-brain architecture organized around Experience → Consolidation → Knowledge → Capability → Behavior → Experience, including dreaming and knowledge maintenance.

### Proactive by Construction
Proactivity is treated as an architectural property of the system rather than a feature added after implementation.

### Compliance-by-Construction
Compliance boundaries are encoded into architecture and execution paths instead of depending exclusively on post-hoc controls.

### Human-in-the-Healing-Loop
Self-healing execution can diagnose and repair automatically where confidence is sufficient and escalate uncertain or invalid cases to human authority.

### Human-Intent-Bound Architecture
Execution authority is bounded by the user's intent and authorization represented by the interaction.

### eXtreme Zero Trust
A security posture applying continuous verification and constrained authority to identity, communication, agents and execution.

### Passwordless Identity
Identity based on cryptographic and trusted interaction proofs rather than passwords. Relevant technologies include Passkeys, WebAuthn, DPoP and mTLS.

### Outcome Acceptance
An explicit evidence boundary that determines whether the requested outcome has actually been achieved.

### Solution as a Service
A service model focused on solving a user's problem and delivering an accepted outcome rather than exposing isolated software functionality.

### User-First
The user's intent, authority and desired outcome are treated as the primary boundaries of the system.

### Devir
A SUISSA concept describing evolutionary development across behavior, agents and runtime systems.

### Agentic Runtime
Runtime infrastructure for stateful agents, communication, supervision, execution, memory and lifecycle management.
